nodes.description: Constant maximum NFT supply (500) used to bound minting and the starting index modulo.
Constant mint price of 0.05 ETH per token used to compute the required payment.
Pseudo-random starting index used for token reveal, set by calcStartingIndex.
Block number recorded to seed the starting index randomness.
Public pause flag toggled by the owner via pause().
Base URI string used by tokenURI, mutable by the owner via setBaseURI.
Payable public mint: mints _count tokens to msg.sender and refunds overpayment via a low-level call.
Owner-only function that derives startingIndex from a stored block hash.
Owner-only function that stores the current block number as the randomness seed.
Owner-only setter for the base token URI.
View helper returning all token IDs owned by a given address.
Owner-only function that mints reserved tokens to the caller and seeds startingIndexBlock.
Owner-only function toggling the paused state variable.
Owner-only function transferring the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
Initializes the ERC721 name/symbol and sets the initial base URI.
Internal override returning the stored base token URI.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, refund receiver and withdrawal beneficiary.
Low-level call sending the overpaid remainder to msg.sender inside mint; external value transfer.
Address.transfer of the full balance to msg.sender in withdrawAll; external value transfer.
Number of tokens requested in mint, supplied by the caller.
New base URI string passed to setBaseURI.
Address whose token list is enumerated in walletOfOwner.
Number of reserved tokens to mint in reserveTokens.
Boolean value written to the paused state variable by pause.
Local in mint holding NFT_PRICE multiplied by _count.
Local in mint holding the overpaid msg.value minus price refunded to the caller.
Local in withdrawAll caching address(this).balance before transfer.
Local in reserveTokens caching totalSupply before the mint loop.
Loop counter used in mint and reserveTokens.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the mint recipient used in _safeMint(msg.sender, totalSupply()).
The caller-supplied _count drives the mint loop bounds and price computation.
mint reads MAX_NEB to enforce the supply cap.
mint reads NFT_PRICE to compute the required payment.
mint computes the local price = NFT_PRICE.mul(_count).
price is subtracted from msg.value to derive the remaining refund in mint.
mint computes the local remaining = msg.value.sub(price).
mint performs an external value call after state updates when remaining > 0.
The refund recipient of the low-level call is the untrusted msg.sender.
The attacker-influenced remaining amount is forwarded in the external call value.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on msg.sender when it is a contract, transferring control to the caller.
The value-bearing call to msg.sender can re-enter mint before completion.
withdrawAll caches address(this).balance in the local balance.
withdrawAll executes the transfer of funds to the owner.
msg.sender is the beneficiary of the withdrawAll transfer.
The cached balance amount is transferred out in withdrawAll.
pause takes the boolean val argument.
pause writes the caller-supplied val into the paused state variable.
reserveTokens takes num as the mint count.
reserveTokens caches totalSupply in the local supply.
reserveTokens writes startingIndexBlock when it is zero.
reserveTokens mints reserved tokens to msg.sender.
calcStartingIndex writes the computed startingIndex.
calcStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to derive the random seed.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock stores block.number into startingIndexBlock.
setBaseURI writes the new URI into _baseTokenURI.
The baseURI parameter is consumed by setBaseURI.
_baseURI returns the stored _baseTokenURI state variable.
The constructor calls setBaseURI to initialize the token URI.
walletOfOwner enumerates tokens using the _owner parameter.
walletOfOwner queries balanceOf(_owner) to size the result array.

normalization_plan.reason: The _count parameter only exists to drive the mint function's price and loop logic.
The baseURI parameter is solely consumed by setBaseURI when writing state.
The _owner parameter is only used by walletOfOwner for enumeration.
The num parameter only controls the reserveTokens mint loop.
The val parameter only exists to set the paused flag in pause.
The local price is an intermediate value fully contained in mint.
The local remaining directly feeds the external refund call in mint.
The local balance is the exact value pushed out by the withdraw transfer.
The local supply is a cached totalSupply used only inside reserveTokens.
The loop counter i is a transient index local to mint's minting loop.
